PageOrientation.description: Page orientation applied on top of a `PageSize`.

oneOf.description: Tall: the page's longer side runs vertically.
Wide: the page's longer side runs horizontally.

PageSize.description: Physical page size for a printed target.

oneOf.description:
A square page sized to the drawn content plus the margin.

The default, and the only size whose extent depends on the target: the
content is fitted into a square box so a printed sheet can be rotated
without changing which markers fit. `PageOrientation` does not apply.
An explicit size in millimeters, given in portrait.

height_mm.description: Page height in millimeters (portrait), greater than 0.

width_mm.description: Page width in millimeters (portrait), greater than 0.

PageSpec.description:
Page size, orientation, and margin for a printed target.

The default is `PageSize::FitContent` with a zero margin — a square page
sized exactly to the target.

margin_mm.description: Uniform white margin in millimeters on every edge (0 or more).

orientation.description:
Orientation applied to `PageSpec::size`. Ignored by
`PageSize::FitContent`, whose page is square.

description:
Options shared by every rendered target format.

One options type covers all formats: the page and scale bar apply to the
SVG and PNG renderings, and `png_dpi` is only consulted by the raster. The
DXF rendering ignores all of them — see
`TargetLayout::render_target_dxf`.

include_scale_bar.description:
Draw the scale bar in the lower-left corner of the printable area.

`true` by default. A consumer that draws its own scale line must set
this to `false`, or the print carries two.

page.description:
Sheet the target is printed on.

Defaults to `PageSize::FitContent` with no margin: a square page sized
exactly to the drawn content.

png_dpi.description:
Raster density (dots per inch, greater than 0) used to convert millimeters into PNG pixels.

Also embedded in the encoded PNG as physical pixel dimensions (`pHYs`)
so the file retains its intended print scale.
